CA.rationale: Attention/processing relation (A) is not expressed explicitly; CA therefore not present.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), an organization-style presentation (pattern of coordinates) and a separate origin/status entry are all explicitly present and bound to p0/current/n2.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

A.rationale: Phrase suggests ephemeral/current vs candidate peaks but does not explicitly link an attention/allocation process to the content's presentation; thus ambiguous.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify items (red) with coordinate attributes.

D.rationale: The report separately records the content coordinates and a distinct origin/status metadata field for the same referent.

O.rationale: Statements and coordinate groupings describe how contents are presented/organized (grid orientation and clustered coordinate patterns).
